long_biography.plain_text:
At Arts High School, property investor Anthony Fernicola played the saxophone and had his own band. Music also ran through his family: his father and uncles were musicians. He later hosted fundraisers for musicians in financial difficulty, and his Brooklyn restaurant, Io, presented live bands.

His charitable work also reflects military service. Fernicola served in the US Army from 1965 to 1967, including a posting in Saigon, and his foundation provides financial help to veterans in need. At Children’s Specialized Hospital in New Jersey, he has helped finance individually fitted wheelchairs for young patients.
